headline: Kyrgyzstan plans to attract up to $500 million from AIIB for infrastructure investments
summary: Kyrgyzstan plans to raise up to $500 million in credit financing from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank for infrastructure projects. The article gives no further terms.
why: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank is a multilateral lender that finances infrastructure in Asia, and its loans add to sovereign borrowing by recipient governments.
original_headline: КР планирует привлечь до $500 миллионов на инфраструктурные инвестиции от АБИИ
